ChatWebSocketMessage.description: Messages sent from client to server over WebSocket.

type.description: Message type: 'message' = chat message, 'cancel' = abort operation, 'answer' = respond to question, 'interrupt' = hard interrupt, 'steer' = drift in message, 'summarize' = LLM-backed note summarize

options.description: Additional options for the chat interaction (optional for 'message' type)

answer.description: Answer to a question (required for 'answer' type)

value.description: Answer value (string/bool/number/array/object depending on question type)

noteId.description: Note ID to summarize (required for 'summarize' type)

websiteUrl.description: Website URL to crawl (required for operation='crawl')

maxPages.description: Max pages to crawl (optional for operation='crawl')

maxWords.description: Max words for summary (optional for 'summarize' type)

focusInstruction.description: Focus instruction for summarization (optional for 'summarize' type)

generateTitle.description: Generate and apply a note title from summarized content

ChatWebSocketEvent.description: Events sent from server to client over WebSocket.

type.description: Event type discriminator for client parsing

data.description: Event payload (shape depends on event type)
